name: Data.exists_test_form_inner_kernelForm
summary: Ξ is a triple xiSum of point forms carrying an integral vector that reads the monomial X^α; its pairing with the kernel form factorises (seesaw in blocks) into the three intAlgPart norms times the rank-12 kernel; it is integral by xiSum_mem and the gauge of delta forms, and tested by stdClassSum_period_eq_zero.

steps.claim: (Part of the statement: it contains `let X := …`, and the line census of the checker takes that := for the declaration's, so these lines count as the value.) X, u, the hypotheses on α and on the characters, and the conclusion.
steps.lean:
l.Coprime ϑ.levelNorm) x₀ : let X := lValueData hE.1 ϑ; let u := @.one P D; (∀ τ, ∑ i, α (τ, i,
      ()) = X.jetDeg τ) → b * ((lValueData H₂.2 ϑ).auxPair.b * (lValueData H₃.2 u).auxPair.b) *
      (lValueData H.2 u).auxPair.b = X.auxPair.b → ∃ Ξ, (∀ g, inner ℂ Ξ (X.kernelForm g) *
      (stdClassSum X.chosenLevel 1 ^ 3 * P.vacuumScale D.s ^ (2 * p.z - 20 + 8)) = (∏ τ, (X.jetDeg
      τ)! :) / α.prod (fun _ k ↦ ↑k !) * q.intAlgPart H.2 u * q₃.intAlgPart H₃.2 u * q₂.intAlgPart
      H₂.2 ϑ * modKernel (stdSpace ..) (stdSpace _ (Fin 12)) 1 b (X.levelModulus 1 false)
      (Pi.single x₀ 1) (.monomial α 1) (1, g) (1, 1)) ∧ X.auxPair.IsTestForm l Ξ := by

steps.claim: Introduce X, u, hα, hb.
steps.lean: intro X u hα hb;

steps.claim: No twist place of X is a chosen place (levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q).
steps.lean:
have hG i : ¬D.IsChosen (X.twistPlace i) :=
    (D.levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q ϑ (.inl i.2)).2.1

steps.claim: An integer vector c whose harmonic polynomial is (∏ jetDeg!/∏ α!)·(the monomial X^α renamed) and which is fixed by the matrices with the columns e of the identity (exists_int_vector_harmonicPoly_eq); l is coprime to the trivial modulus; the trivial twist has no twist places.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨c, hc, hr⟩, k, e⟩ := exists_int_vector_harmonicPoly_eq X (.trans .inl .inl) hα,
    (.prod_right nofun : l.Coprime u.levelNorm), (⟨nofun⟩ : IsEmpty (D.levelPlaces u).TwistIndex)

steps.claim: Let F(h₁, h₂, h₃) be the point form of X's auxiliary pair at the block point (1 ⊕ (h₂ ⊕ h₃)) ⊕ h₁, with the residue matrices built from x₀ and inclusion matrices, the embedding of the chosen indices, and the vector c.
steps.lean:
let F h₁ h₂ h₃ := pointForm (O := X.auxPair) (Y := fun i ↦
    fromRows (fromRows (x₀.map (modulusResidue _ (places_levelModulus_false.ge ⟨_,
    rfl⟩))) (fromRows (inclMatrix _ chosenIndexEmb) (inclMatrix _ chosenIndexEmb)))
    (inclMatrix _ (lValueData H.2 u).auxPair.incl)) (U.blockSumOne (U.blockSumOne (1, U.blockSumOne
    (h₂, h₃)), h₁)) (fun _ _ _ h ↦ inclMatrix_mulVecLin_injective _ _ congr($h ∘ .inr))
    (chosenIndexEmb.trans (.trans .inl (.trans .inr .inl))) ((↑) ∘ c)

steps.claim: Take Ξ = xiSum H₂ ϑ (h₂ ↦ xiSum H₃ u (h₃ ↦ xiSum H u (F · h₂ h₃))). The pairing identity follows by smul_apply_xiSum three times (step 6); integrality by xiSum_mem three times and the gauge of delta forms (step 7); testing by xiSum_mem and orthogonality (steps 8–12).
steps.lean:
refine ⟨xiSum H₂ ϑ fun h₂ ↦ xiSum H₃ u fun h₃ ↦ xiSum H u (F · h₂ h₃), fun g ↦ .trans (by
    simp [-classSum_mul]; ring!) (smul_apply_xiSum _ g fun _ _ ↦ smul_apply_xiSum _ g fun _ _ ↦
    smul_apply_xiSum (L := innerSLFlip ℂ _) _ g fun _ _ ↦ ?_), fun _ ↦ xiSum_mem _ hl fun _ ↦
    xiSum_mem _ k fun _ ↦ xiSum_mem _ k fun _ _ ↦
    (weylGauge_deltaForm_le isOfFinOrder_level_char).trans ?_, fun w hw hS ↦ (restrictScalars_mem
    embValRing ..).1 (xiSum_mem _ hl fun _ ↦ xiSum_mem _ k fun _ y hy ↦ inner_eq_zero_symm.1 ?_)⟩

steps.claim: The functional h ↦ ⟨F(h), kernel form⟩: by theta_eq_inner_kernelForm it is θ of the point form, i.e. theta_pointForm, with the harmonic polynomial of step 3 (hc) and linearity (modKernelBilin).
steps.lean:
· erw [innerSLFlip_apply_apply, ← inner_conj_symm, ← X.theta_eq_inner_kernelForm, theta_pointForm,
      hc, ← modKernelBilin_apply]
    rw [mul_assoc (modKernel ..), ← hb]
    simp +singlePass (disch := simp +instances [levelModulus, levelPlaces, X, sq, ↓prod_of_isEmpty,
      *, funext_iff, Ideal.mul_le_left.trans]) only [↓kernelForm_of_jetDeg_eq_zero, modKernel,
      ← modDatum_factor (𝔪' := X.levelModulus 2), ← modKernel.eq_1]
    simp_rw [← modKernelI_block (.refl _)]
    simp [prod_eq_zero_iff, AuxPair.a]; congr! 2; obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ :=
      _root_.Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp_left.comp_left ‹_›
    simp [(X.levelModulus 1 false).matrix_ext_modulusResidue X.isConjApart_chosenPlace.1, ← ext_iff,
      AuxPair.resDetDatum, X, ψ_eq_one, hG, univ_eq_empty, forall_and, ← ite_and]; congr! 1; tauto

steps.claim: Use the character identity hb.
steps.lean: rw [mul_assoc (modKernel ..), ← hb]

steps.claim: Reduce the moduli: the kernel modulo the level of X is the kernel modulo X.levelModulus 2 composed with the reduction (modDatum_factor), and the kernel form vanishes where the jet degree is 0 (kernelForm_of_jetDeg_eq_zero).
steps.lean:
simp +singlePass (disch := simp +instances [levelModulus, levelPlaces, X, sq, ↓prod_of_isEmpty,
      *, funext_iff, Ideal.mul_le_left.trans]) only [↓kernelForm_of_jetDeg_eq_zero, modKernel,
      ← modDatum_factor (𝔪' := X.levelModulus 2), ← modKernel.eq_1]

steps.claim: Split the kernel of the block space into the product of the kernels of the blocks (modKernelI_block).
steps.lean: simp_rw [← modKernelI_block (.refl _)]

steps.claim: Compare the data: lift the residue matrix T to O_E.
steps.lean:
simp [prod_eq_zero_iff, AuxPair.a]; congr! 2; obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ :=
      _root_.Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp_left.comp_left ‹_›

steps.claim: By the Chinese remainder theorem at the chosen places (matrix_ext_modulusResidue) and ψ = 1 off the twist places (no twist place is chosen: step 2), the residue datum is the indicator of x₀.
steps.lean:
simp [(X.levelModulus 1 false).matrix_ext_modulusResidue X.isConjApart_chosenPlace.1, ← ext_iff,
      AuxPair.resDetDatum, X, ψ_eq_one, hG, univ_eq_empty, forall_and, ← ite_and]; congr! 1; tauto

steps.claim: Integrality of the point forms: the gauge is invariant under K₀ (weylGauge_mul) and the vector c is integral (hr, integer entries).
steps.lean:
· erw [weylGauge_mul _ (Kf_le_localLevel _), weylGauge, hr] <;> simp [← map_inv, U.sum,
      funext_iff, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg, norm_intCast_le_one]

steps.claim: Testing: unfold xiSum and the trivial lift as class sums and exchange the class sums.
steps.lean:
simp [xiSum, Pair.trivialLift, apply_eq_evalForm, LValueData.trivialLift, map_classSum, mul_assoc,
    ← mul_classSum, classSum_comm (K' := levelOf _ ⊥), ← innerSLFlip_apply_apply]; repeat right

steps.claim: Every inner product of y (good, orthogonal to the kernel of θ, killed by the Hecke polynomial at the test value) with the class sums of point forms vanishes by stdClassSum_period_eq_zero (FitsParams, ψ ≠ 1 on Q, the reflection sums kill y (step 10), θy = 0, the Hecke condition, the rank inequality, C = the Gram pairing with 1, and the conditions on the level checked in steps 11–12).
steps.lean:
refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun g ↦
    smul_eq_zero_of_right _ (stdClassSum_period_eq_zero X.fitsParams_auxPair (by simpa [X, ψ_eq_one,
    hG] using! (ϑ.psi_ne_one _ ·.2)) (fun i _ v ↦ hy.1.1.choose_spec ▸ ?_) hy.2
    hy.1.2 (by simp; grind [IsRankOne, le_m]) (.refl _) _ (.toSpanSingleton .. ∘ₛₗ gramForm (κ :=
    (lValueData H.2 u).auxPair.κ).flip 1) (fun _ _ _ f ↦ ?_) ?_ (one_mem _) (fun _ ↦ by
    simp [kernelForm_of_jetDeg_eq_zero, kernelVector, nablaBasis_eq_one, H.1, funext_iff,
      gramForm_apply, ← apply_eq_evalForm, dot_mulVec_eq_sum_sum,
    ← mul_sum, ← sum_mul, AuxPair.a]; ring!) rfl fun j hj ↦ ?_)

steps.claim: The reflection sums kill the image of the label idempotent (reflectionSum_mul_labelIdem for the twisted label of the rank-one pair).
steps.lean:
· erw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul,
      piTensorElem_mul_eq_zero i (reflectionSum_mul_labelIdem ((isApt_rank_one _
      hE).isLabel_twistedLabel (O := X.auxPair) i ∘ by simp +contextual [twistedLabel]) v)]; simp

steps.claim: Equivariance of C (conjugate Weyl representation of a fixed vector).
steps.lean: simp [conjWeylRep, hr, f]

steps.claim: Simplify the Weyl representations at the trivial twist.
steps.lean:
iterate 2 simp [weylRep, schur_eq_one, H.1, places_levelModulus, X, u, levelPlaces,
    twist_one_spec]

steps.claim: For k in the level, the columns of the reduction at the chosen places are fixed (mem_stabilizer_col_iff).
steps.lean: have J i := mem_stabilizer_col_iff.1 ((mem_levelOf.1 hj).2 (.inl i) ⟨⟩)

steps.claim: The level conditions of stdClassSum_period_eq_zero: the residue datum is fixed, and the block matrix reduces as required (map_block_eq_blockGL), leaving one condition per index.
steps.lean:
use by simp_all [AuxPair.resDetDatum, ↓Matrix.map_mul, ↓reductionK₀_map_modulusResidue,
    inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul_of_invertible, Kf.reduceFamily, univ_eq_empty, -Sum.elim_inl], by
    simpa using (map_block_eq_blockGL (reduceAt w) _ 1 j).1, fun i ↦ ?_

steps.lean: simp; erw [(map_block_eq_blockGL _ _ 1 j).2, fromBlocks_mul_fromRows]

steps.claim: Conclude with step 13 (fromRows_ext_iff).
steps.lean: simpa +instances [fromRows_ext_iff] using! J i
